page.title: Vocabulary
page.lead: Words you saved while reading. Each comes back on its own schedule twice: once to recall its meaning, once to type it into the sentence you met it in.

session.title: Due today
session.more: {{count}} more are due today after this session.
session.rateLabel: How well did you know it?
session.failed: That review was not saved. Try again.
session.rateLabelCard: How well did you know this card?

list.title: Your words
list.empty: No words saved yet. Select a passage while reading, choose Vocabulary, then Find words to save.

picker.cost: Asks your reading model once for a list of terms from this passage.
picker.title: Words in this passage
picker.none: The model found no words in this passage to save.

speech.title: Reading aloud
speech.remote: online: the text is sent to your browser's maker
speech.remoteNote: Voices marked online send the text to your browser's maker to be spoken. Voices on this device do not.
speech.noVoice: Your browser has no voice for {{lang}}. Choose a voice for another language to hear it anyway.

home.title: Vocabulary due
home.none: No word cards are due today.

bookCards.title: Book cards
bookCards.lead: Cards from the living books you have written. They come back on the same schedule as your words, in a queue of their own.
bookCards.empty: No book cards yet. Open a book made from a knowledge base; its flash-card blocks add their cards here.

decide.legend: What will you do with this word?
decide.hint: Decide before you look the meaning up. Only a word you choose to learn comes back for review.

when.skip: It does not change the gist, the next step or anyone's safety.
when.infer: The sentence, a contrast or an example gives you enough to go on.
when.lookup: It blocks you now but you are unlikely to need it again.
when.learn: It keeps coming back, matters to the task, and you will use it within two weeks.
when.verify: Safety, law, health, money, versions or someone's responsibility depends on it.

fieldHints.sound: How it sounds: stress, or a respelling.
fieldHints.collocation: The words it usually comes with.
fieldHints.cue: The situation that should bring it to mind.
fieldHints.learnRetest: The retest is the review schedule: two cards come back from tomorrow.
fieldHints.owner: Who answers for this term in your situation.

decide.suggestionHidden: Write your candidate sense first; the suggestion appears after.
decide.suggestionNote: A model's suggestion is a candidate, not a source.
decide.already: You already decided on this word: {{decision}}.

week.select: That is {{count}} words to learn this week. Five to eight a cycle is plenty: keep the ones that recur, matter to the task and that you will use soon.
week.over: That is {{count}} words to learn this week, more than the five to eight a cycle can hold. Consider skipping, inferring or looking some of them up instead.

practise.hint: A production card starts from a situation and asks you to produce the word. Write a situation of your own where you would use it.
practise.confusable: A confusable expression, and the difference (optional)
practise.failed: The production card was not saved.

byDecision.title: Other decisions
byDecision.lead: Words you decided not to learn deliberately. They have no review cards.

audit.title: Add to a vocabulary audit
audit.lead: Copy the selected words into the decision queue of an open vocabulary audit, with their task impact, decision and basis. The audit keeps its own copy.
audit.none: You have no open vocabulary audit.
audit.full: The audit's queue is full after {{count}} words; the rest were not added.
audit.nothing: Select at least one word first.

listen.prompt: Play the line and type the word you hear.
listen.player: The line the word was saved from
listen.gone: The video or recording this line came from is gone, so here is the line to read instead.

anki.media_other: {{count}} images or sounds will be left out.

anki.willSkip_other: {{count}} notes have no word or no meaning, or are too long, and will be skipped.

anki.failed_other: The import stopped after {{count}} words. Choose the deck again to bring in the rest; words already imported are skipped.
